prior_exposure: Uehara 2023 article and public GSE199329 metadata; no matrix read
hypothesis: SLC34A2-associated phosphate homeostasis constrains transition-associated epithelial stress; timing, mediation and reversibility are separate predictions.

predictions.H1: Verified SLC34A2 disruption changes an independently defined epithelial state endpoint.
predictions.H2: A measured relevant transport/phosphate change contributes beyond generic or secondary mineral/inflammatory injury.
predictions.H3: The state response occurs before a prespecified broad identity-loss endpoint, given linked temporal evidence.
predictions.H4: Verified restoration reduces the state response; mature recovery is a separate functional endpoint.

stages.name: Verify inherited SLC34A2 phenotype
stages.purpose: Preserve Nb3 contrasts, the seven-versus-eight well distinction and existing counterexamples

stages.name: Resolve sources, sampling and endpoint eligibility
stages.purpose: Separate discovery, external case context, homeostasis measurements and repair references

stages.name: External PAM epithelial phenotype and composition
stages.purpose: Describe transition/identity RNA within eligible epithelial cells while retaining donor, age and sorting confounding
outputs: per-library epithelial annotation and descriptive marker tables

stages.name: Transport/phosphate versus secondary injury
stages.purpose: Determine which source measurements distinguish a transport-associated epithelial response from mineral/inflammatory injury

stages.name: Temporal ordering before identity loss
stages.purpose: Test whether verified homeostatic disruption precedes a state change while an independently defined identity endpoint is retained

stages.name: Restoration and mature epithelial recovery
stages.purpose: Separate reversibility of RNA state from restoration of transport, viability and mature lineage-derived function

stages.name: Synthesize and refine A23
stages.purpose: Update distinct predictions without treating descriptive human disease context as causal validation

P2.biological_design: Paper reports one PAM explant and one control; two PAM fractions are not two patients.
P2.allowed_inference: descriptive case context only; no population or genotype effect
P2.first_action: Audit processed HDF5 inventory, epithelial coverage, annotation and ortholog mapping without fitting contrasts.
P2.human_ortholog_map: must resolve and freeze before scoring; no silent replacement of missing genes
forbidden: p-values or biological CIs from cells as replicates
combining CD45 fractions to estimate tissue composition without sampling weights
correcting away disease/donor confounding with batch integration
inferring time or maturation from pseudotime
selecting cells by low SLC34A2 and reporting target-low phenotype as independent evidence
freeze_before_scoring: human gene map and missingness/coverage rules
separate individual markers, identity and transition endpoints

time_gate: state and independent identity endpoints in linked units
independent biological replication and identifiable design
restoration_gate: verified normalization in the relevant compartment
matched restoration comparison and source specificity
independently measured mature lineage/function endpoint for recovery
source_constraints: Intracellular phosphate, alveolar soluble phosphate, mineral burden and systemic phosphate are different measurements.
Conditioning on treatment-induced identity, survival or mineral burden is not a causal mediation test.
Unrelated repair and NKX2-1 datasets provide context, not an SLC34A2 intervention.
